questions.question: What did Moses do wrong at the waters of Meribah?
options: He offered strange fire before the LORD
He struck the rock instead of speaking to it
He doubted God openly before the elders
He stubbornly refused to gather all the people together
questions.answer: He struck the rock instead of speaking to it

questions.question: What was the consequence for Moses and Aaron?
options: They would not bring Israel into the promised land
They would lose their honored place among the holy priests
They would be replaced by younger leaders
They would be sent back to live in Egypt
questions.answer: They would not bring Israel into the promised land

questions.question: Both Miriam and Aaron died in this chapter.
God told Moses to speak to the rock, but instead he _____ it twice.
_____ died on Mount Hor, and his garments were given to his son Eleazar.
